essence: Clouds thundering make travelers long; sorrow grows in those, endless.
They honor the love-festival with beloveds; cloud-arrival, dear friend, they bring.
May I be conquered by which poet, by yamakas, other; to him I pour water in ghaṭakarpara.
The lament and beauty are framed by the poet's skill; the poem is self-referential, not narrative.
